title: Built Smacked Right Back
style: rock, punchy electro-rock / phonk-pop hybrid, confident male vocal, chantable chorus, sharp stop-start rhythm, triumphant build, fast singing, smooth trumpet solos, electronica, powerful basslines, men's choir, pop, smooth, electro, vocal

You felt the page turn
Felt the whole thing click
Not a napkin plan
Not a skeleton trick
When the signal comes through
Let the whole thing sing
From the spine to the site
Let the true notes ring

[Chorus]
Built smacked right back
Yeah the terminal said that
No stop-and-chat bot
We don't drift like that
Sweet ride
Hard line
